title: M3LB: a lattice Boltzmann solver in two independent implementations, with the code, data and analysis of "Walls or cascade? A pre-registered test of wall dissipation in decaying magnetohydrodynamic turbulence"
description: M3LB is a lattice Boltzmann solver in C++20 on Kokkos (src/, validation/, demonstrator/) with a second, independent implementation in CUDA (GPU/). This archive is the release cited by the paper in paper/tg_mhd/: its source, its supplementary material, the job scripts with the pre-registered decision rules (GPU/csf3/), the time series and wall-distance profiles of every run (results/P_tg_mhd/), the analysis tools (tools/tg_mhd_*.py), the script that prints every number in the paper (paper/tg_mhd/numbers.py), and GitHub's server-side record of when the protocol's commits were pushed (paper/tg_mhd/provenance/).
